minutes.headline: Sewer Commission waived the grease trap non-compliance fee for El Forno on a split vote and approved two stabilization articles.
minutes.summary: The commission debated whether to waive a non-compliance fee on a restaurant that missed grease trap reporting, and voted to impose no penalty over one dissent. It reviewed a list of eleven concerns on the 200-unit 40B project for the Zoning Board of Appeals, centered on sewer extension costs and connection fees. It approved two stabilization articles for the special town meeting warrant, agreed to submit three ARPA projects, and accepted minutes.

public_comment.topic: The restaurant owner thanked the commission for the decision and promised to follow up on grease trap reports, withholding payment from the grease trap company until a copy of the filed report is given.

votes.motion: Impose no penalties or non-compliance fee on the restaurant for missed grease trap reporting, given the circumstances.
Accept the two stabilization fund articles as written for the warrant.
Start the non-compliance process for Crossroads Plaza: invoice the non-compliance fee and give 30 days, with a daily charge back to the due date.
Accept the business manager's change of her retirement date.
Accept the minutes of the second meeting (August 30th).

what_happened.line: The Sewer Commission voted to impose no penalty on a restaurant that missed grease trap reporting; one nay was heard.
The commission went through a list of concerns on the 40B housing project, to be sent to the Zoning Board of Appeals and department heads with added wording on lost connection fees.
The commission accepted the two stabilization fund articles, as written, for the special town meeting warrant.
Bill will submit three separate ARPA projects and await an engineer's cost estimate, with a possible quick meeting before the 30th deadline.
A vote to start the non-compliance process for Crossroads Plaza was recorded, but the result was not audible in the recording.

why_it_matters: The sewer department pays for itself from fees, so connection fees the 40B project does not pay would come out of sewer retained earnings, which the commission said could strain the department.

The two stabilization articles and the ARPA project list are money decisions that will reach special town meeting and the town's grant requests, and residents who vote there will see the stabilization articles.
watch_next: The 30th deadline for ARPA project submissions, and the engineer's cost estimate the commission is waiting on.
The special town meeting warrant carrying the two stabilization articles.
